# Orrinwave Data Systems — support terms (extract)

Architecture-specific packages (arm64) may trail the x86 package by up to twelve business days. Premium-support customers may request early access for the fee printed on the advisory (OWA-2026-052: USD 750). Every package is production-eligible the next business day after release, once the customer's canary soak passes. Builds staged from a withdrawn revision are not supported.
